what_this_is: A derived-split reference pinned by hash, NOT a new umbrella lock asset. It adds no entry to docs/datasets.lock.json, materializes no new audio, and is never resolved through data.lock or data.carriers. The only audio this study sends stays the locked earnings22-original MP3 bytes D1 already closed over; this table supplies the published segment BOUNDARIES those bytes are cut at, and the published reference SENTENCES they are scored against.

upstream.license_note: the split is a repartition of the Rev Earnings-22 corpus this study already licenses under its earnings22-original lock entry
upstream.esb_validation_note: recorded for completeness only; the validation calls are NOT read by this study and stay confirmatory

extraction.method: pyarrow ParquetFile.read(columns=[...]) over huggingface_hub.HfFileSystem at the pinned revision -- a COLUMN PROJECTION, so the 'audio' column is never materialized

extracted_table.format: JSONL, one object per segment, sort_keys, LF, UTF-8
extracted_table.location_basis: under the controlled data root, never in Git and never inside the locked carrier tree: the 'sentence' column is gold reference text

unresolved.row_count_discrepancy: this table carries 2735 test rows; the leaderboard config hf-audio/open-asr-leaderboard reports 2741 for the same Earnings22 column, and the NVIDIA NeMo AutoModel post that publishes the 9.79 target states N = 2741. The 6-row gap is UNEXPLAINED. It is recorded, not reconciled: no row is invented, dropped or re-cut to close it, and every number this study reports is over the 2,735 rows this pinned table actually contains.
unresolved.timestamp_precision: start_ts/end_ts are float32 in the upstream parquet, so a boundary carries about 1e-4 s of representation error at these magnitudes; the cut is made at the float32 value verbatim rather than at a re-rounded one
